explication: Amgi is an offline-first, Anki-compatible flashcard app for iOS, with watchOS and widget companions. The main workflow is to manage decks and cards, study a scheduled review queue, and sync collection changes with a compatible server. The SwiftUI features call dependency-client interfaces, which lead through service facades and typed protobuf requests to Anki’s Rust engine. Other major capabilities include browsing and editing cards, EPUB reading with offline dictionary lookup, statistics, templates, image occlusion, and Shortcuts. Some feature-level links are documented rather than verified in sampled implementation excerpts.
